unit-disallowed-list.message: Use rem or em, which follow the reader's font size. Only a 1px border may be written in px.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Lay out with the flow of the page. A negative offset or an absolute position compensates for spacing the theme owns, and breaks when it changes.

selector-class-pattern.message: Style only the v- classes of these pages and the hooks Mintlify documents (.card, .code-block, .dark), never the utility classes it renders.

selector-id-pattern.message: Style only the ids Mintlify documents.

selector-attribute-name-disallowed-list.message: Match a documented hook, not the class or style attributes Mintlify renders.

color-no-hex.message: Write colors in tokens.css and use them with var().

color-named.message: Write colors in tokens.css and use them with var().

function-disallowed-list.message: Write colors in tokens.css and use them with var().
